WITH c AS (
  SELECT player_id, SUM(g) AS g, SUM(r) AS r, SUM(h) AS h, SUM(hr) AS hr
  FROM batting GROUP BY player_id
),
mx AS (
  SELECT MAX(g) AS g, MAX(r) AS r, MAX(h) AS h, MAX(hr) AS hr FROM c
)
SELECT 'games played' AS stat, p.name_given, c.g AS score
FROM c JOIN player p ON p.player_id = c.player_id
WHERE c.g = (SELECT g FROM mx)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'runs', p.name_given, c.r
FROM c JOIN player p ON p.player_id = c.player_id
WHERE c.r = (SELECT r FROM mx)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hits', p.name_given, c.h
FROM c JOIN player p ON p.player_id = c.player_id
WHERE c.h = (SELECT h FROM mx)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'home runs', p.name_given, c.hr
FROM c JOIN player p ON p.player_id = c.player_id
WHERE c.hr = (SELECT hr FROM mx);

WITH runs AS (
  SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS r
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id=b.match_id AND bs.over_id=b.over_id AND bs.ball_id=b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no=b.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
ex AS (
  SELECT b.bowler, SUM(e.extra_runs) AS x
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  JOIN extra_runs e ON e.match_id=b.match_id AND e.over_id=b.over_id AND e.ball_id=b.ball_id AND e.innings_no=b.innings_no
  WHERE e.extra_type IN ('wides','noballs')
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
wk AS (
  SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) AS w
  FROM wicket_taken w
  JOIN ball_by_ball b ON b.match_id=w.match_id AND b.over_id=w.over_id AND b.ball_id=w.ball_id AND b.innings_no=w.innings_no
  WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field')
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
avg_tbl AS (
  SELECT wk.bowler, (COALESCE(runs.r,0)+COALESCE(ex.x,0))*1.0/wk.w AS bowling_avg, wk.w AS wickets
  FROM wk
  LEFT JOIN runs ON runs.bowler=wk.bowler
  LEFT JOIN ex ON ex.bowler=wk.bowler
)
SELECT p.player_name, a.bowling_avg, a.wickets
FROM avg_tbl a
JOIN player p ON p.player_id=a.bowler
WHERE a.bowling_avg = (SELECT MIN(bowling_avg) FROM avg_tbl);

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM (
  SELECT bb.match_id, bb.striker, bb.team_batting, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs
    ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id
   AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
  GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker, bb.team_batting
  HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
) s
JOIN match m ON m.match_id = s.match_id
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = s.striker
WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND s.team_batting <> m.match_winner
  AND s.team_batting IN (m.team_1, m.team_2);

WITH r AS (
  SELECT bb.striker AS pid, bb.match_id, bs.runs_scored
  FROM ball_by_ball bb
  JOIN batsman_scored bs
    ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id
   AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
  JOIN match m ON m.match_id = bb.match_id
  WHERE m.season_id = 5
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       ROUND(SUM(r.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT r.match_id), 2) AS batting_average_runs_per_match
FROM r
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = r.pid
GROUP BY r.pid
ORDER BY batting_average_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH runs AS (
  SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, runs_scored AS r FROM batsman_scored
  UNION ALL
  SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, extra_runs AS r FROM extra_runs
),
ov AS (
  SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler, SUM(r.r) AS total
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  JOIN runs r ON r.match_id = b.match_id AND r.innings_no = b.innings_no
             AND r.over_id = b.over_id AND r.ball_id = b.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler
),
mx AS (SELECT match_id, MAX(total) AS m FROM ov GROUP BY match_id),
top AS (
  SELECT ov.* FROM ov JOIN mx ON ov.match_id = mx.match_id AND ov.total = mx.m
),
best AS (
  SELECT bowler, MAX(total) AS best_over FROM top GROUP BY bowler
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT bowler, best_over, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY best_over DESC) AS rk FROM best
)
SELECT p.player_name AS bowler, rk.best_over AS max_runs_in_single_over, t.match_id, t.innings_no, t.over_id
FROM ranked rk
JOIN top t ON t.bowler = rk.bowler AND t.total = rk.best_over
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = rk.bowler
WHERE rk.rk <= 3
ORDER BY rk.best_over DESC, t.match_id;

SELECT strftime('%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2016' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2016",
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2017",
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2018"
FROM olist_orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
GROUP BY strftime('%m', order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month;

WITH order_cat AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id, t.product_category_name_english AS category
  FROM olist_order_items i
  JOIN olist_products pr ON pr.product_id = i.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = pr.product_category_name
),
cat_pay AS (
  SELECT oc.category, p.payment_type, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM order_cat oc
  JOIN olist_order_payments p ON p.order_id = oc.order_id
  GROUP BY oc.category, p.payment_type
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY n DESC) AS rn
  FROM cat_pay
)
SELECT category, payment_type, n AS payments
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH cat_hours AS (
  SELECT c.name AS category,
         SUM((julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date)) * 24) AS total_rental_hours
  FROM rental r
  JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id
  JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id
  JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id
  JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
  WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL
    AND (ci.city LIKE 'A%' OR ci.city LIKE '%-%')
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
)
SELECT category, total_rental_hours
FROM cat_hours
WHERE total_rental_hours = (SELECT MAX(total_rental_hours) FROM cat_hours);

SELECT t.boroname, COUNT(*) AS tree_count, AVG(i.Estimate_Mean_income) AS avg_mean_income
FROM trees t
JOIN income_trees i ON i.zipcode = t.zipcode
WHERE i.Estimate_Median_income > 0 AND i.Estimate_Mean_income > 0
  AND t.boroname IN ('Bronx','Brooklyn','Manhattan','Queens','Staten Island')
GROUP BY t.boroname
ORDER BY tree_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH top AS (
  SELECT industry FROM companies_industries
  GROUP BY industry ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT i.industry,
       COUNT(*) AS companies_joined_2019_2021,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 3, 2) AS avg_new_per_year
FROM companies_dates d
JOIN companies_industries i ON i.company_id = d.company_id
WHERE i.industry = (SELECT industry FROM top)
  AND strftime('%Y', d.date_joined) IN ('2019', '2020', '2021')
GROUP BY i.industry;

WITH us_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, cu.cust_city AS city, t.calendar_quarter_id AS q, s.amount_sold
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
  JOIN times t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
  WHERE co.country_iso_code = 'US' AND s.promo_id = 999 AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772,1776)
),
city_growth AS (
  SELECT city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q=1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS s19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q=1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS s20
  FROM us_sales GROUP BY city
  HAVING s20 >= 1.2 * s19 AND s19 > 0
),
f AS (
  SELECT u.* FROM us_sales u JOIN city_growth g ON g.city = u.city
),
prod_q AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q=1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS p19,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q=1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS p20
  FROM f GROUP BY prod_id
),
tot AS (
  SELECT SUM(p19) AS t19, SUM(p20) AS t20, COUNT(*) AS n FROM prod_q
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT p.*, (p.p19 + p.p20) AS total_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (p.p19 + p.p20) DESC) AS rk,
    (SELECT n FROM tot) AS n
  FROM prod_q p
),
shares AS (
  SELECT r.prod_id, r.total_sales, r.rk, r.n,
    100.0 * r.p19 / (SELECT t19 FROM tot) AS share19,
    100.0 * r.p20 / (SELECT t20 FROM tot) AS share20
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE r.rk <= 0.2 * r.n
)
SELECT p.prod_id, p.prod_name, s.total_sales, s.share19, s.share20,
  (s.share20 - s.share19) AS pp_change
FROM shares s
JOIN products p ON p.prod_id = s.prod_id
ORDER BY ABS(s.share20 - s.share19) ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH yc_pid AS (SELECT TRIM(PID) AS PID FROM Person WHERE TRIM(Name) = 'Yash Chopra'),
yc_movies AS (SELECT DISTINCT MID FROM M_Director WHERE TRIM(PID) IN (SELECT PID FROM yc_pid)),
actor_yc AS (SELECT TRIM(c.PID) AS APID, COUNT(DISTINCT c.MID) AS n FROM M_Cast c WHERE c.MID IN (SELECT MID FROM yc_movies) GROUP BY APID),
actor_other AS (
  SELECT APID, MAX(n) AS mx FROM (
    SELECT TRIM(c.PID) AS APID, TRIM(d.PID) AS dpid, COUNT(DISTINCT c.MID) AS n
    FROM M_Cast c JOIN M_Director d ON d.MID = c.MID
    WHERE TRIM(d.PID) NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM yc_pid)
    GROUP BY APID, dpid
  ) GROUP BY APID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS actors_more_with_yash_chopra
FROM actor_yc a LEFT JOIN actor_other o ON o.APID = a.APID
WHERE a.n > COALESCE(o.mx, 0);

WITH scores AS (
  SELECT mp.StyleID,
         SUM(CASE mp.PreferenceSeq WHEN 1 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TotalWeightedScore
  FROM Musical_Preferences mp
  GROUP BY mp.StyleID
)
SELECT s.StyleID,
       ms.StyleName,
       s.TotalWeightedScore,
       ABS(s.TotalWeightedScore - (SELECT AVG(TotalWeightedScore) FROM scores)) AS AbsDiffFromAvg
FROM scores s
LEFT JOIN Musical_Styles ms ON ms.StyleID = s.StyleID
ORDER BY s.TotalWeightedScore DESC;

WITH s AS (
  SELECT salespersonid AS id, CAST(strftime('%Y', orderdate) AS INTEGER) AS yr, SUM(subtotal) AS total_sales
  FROM salesorderheader WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
),
q AS (
  SELECT BusinessEntityID AS id, CAST(strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS INTEGER) AS yr, SUM(SalesQuota) AS annual_quota
  FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory GROUP BY 1, 2
),
k AS (SELECT id, yr FROM s UNION SELECT id, yr FROM q)
SELECT k.id AS salesperson_id, k.yr AS year,
       COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
       COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0) AS annual_quota,
       COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0) AS difference
FROM k
LEFT JOIN s ON s.id = k.id AND s.yr = k.yr
LEFT JOIN q ON q.id = k.id AND q.yr = k.yr
ORDER BY k.id, k.yr;

WITH dm AS (
  SELECT d.name_id, m.id AS movie_id, m.date_published, m.duration
  FROM director_mapping d
  JOIN movies m ON m.id = d.movie_id
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT name_id,
         julianday(date_published) - julianday(LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published)) AS gap
  FROM dm
),
agg AS (
  SELECT name_id, COUNT(*) AS movie_count, SUM(duration) AS total_duration
  FROM dm GROUP BY name_id
),
gavg AS (
  SELECT name_id, AVG(gap) AS avg_gap FROM gaps GROUP BY name_id
),
rat AS (
  SELECT d.name_id,
         ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
         SUM(r.total_votes) AS total_votes,
         MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
         MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating
  FROM dm d JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = d.movie_id
  GROUP BY d.name_id
)
SELECT n.id, n.name, a.movie_count,
       ROUND(g.avg_gap) AS avg_inter_movie_days,
       rat.avg_rating, rat.total_votes, rat.min_rating, rat.max_rating,
       a.total_duration
FROM agg a
JOIN names n ON n.id = a.name_id
LEFT JOIN gavg g ON g.name_id = a.name_id
LEFT JOIN rat ON rat.name_id = a.name_id
ORDER BY a.movie_count DESC, a.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9;

WITH firsts AS (
  SELECT t.id_bioguide, MIN(t.term_start) AS first_start
  FROM legislators_terms t
  GROUP BY t.id_bioguide
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT f.id_bioguide, l.gender, CAST(substr(f.first_start,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS y0
  FROM firsts f JOIN legislators l ON l.id_bioguide = f.id_bioguide
  WHERE l.gender IN ('M','F')
),
fs AS (
  SELECT t.id_bioguide, t.state FROM legislators_terms t
  JOIN firsts f ON f.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide AND t.term_start = f.first_start
  GROUP BY t.id_bioguide
),
offsets(k) AS (
  SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
ret AS (
  SELECT c.id_bioguide, c.gender, o.k,
    MAX(CASE WHEN t.term_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kept
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN offsets o
  LEFT JOIN legislators_terms t
    ON t.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
   AND t.term_start <= printf('%04d-12-31', c.y0 + o.k)
   AND t.term_end   >= printf('%04d-12-31', c.y0 + o.k)
  GROUP BY c.id_bioguide, c.gender, o.k
),
rates AS (
  SELECT fs.state, r.gender, r.k, AVG(r.kept) AS rate
  FROM ret r JOIN fs ON fs.id_bioguide = r.id_bioguide
  GROUP BY fs.state, r.gender, r.k
)
SELECT state
FROM rates
GROUP BY state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender='M' AND rate>0 THEN k END) = 6
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender='F' AND rate>0 THEN k END) = 6
ORDER BY state;

WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT 1790 UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y < 2030),
first_term AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(CAST(substr(term_start,1,4) AS INTEGER)) AS first_year
  FROM legislators_terms GROUP BY id_bioguide
)
SELECT (yr.y - ft.first_year) AS years_since_first,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.id_bioguide) AS active_legislators
FROM years yr
JOIN legislators_terms t
  ON t.state = 'LA'
 AND t.term_start <= yr.y || '-12-31'
 AND t.term_end >= yr.y || '-12-31'
JOIN legislators l ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide AND l.gender = 'M'
JOIN first_term ft ON ft.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
WHERE (yr.y - ft.first_year) > 30 AND (yr.y - ft.first_year) < 50
GROUP BY years_since_first
ORDER BY years_since_first;

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT d.driver_id, o.order_created_year AS y, o.order_created_month AS m, o.order_created_day AS dd, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM deliveries d
  JOIN orders o ON o.delivery_order_id = d.delivery_order_id
  WHERE d.driver_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.driver_id, y, m, dd
)
SELECT driver_id, AVG(n) AS avg_daily_deliveries, COUNT(*) AS active_days
FROM daily
GROUP BY driver_id
ORDER BY avg_daily_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH hi AS (
  SELECT m.id, g.genre
  FROM movies m
  JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = m.id
  JOIN genre g ON g.movie_id = m.id
  WHERE r.avg_rating > 8
),
top_g AS (
  SELECT genre FROM hi GROUP BY genre ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT id) DESC LIMIT 3
)
SELECT n.name AS director, COUNT(DISTINCT hi.id) AS movie_count
FROM hi
JOIN director_mapping d ON d.movie_id = hi.id
JOIN names n ON n.id = d.name_id
WHERE hi.genre IN (SELECT genre FROM top_g)
GROUP BY n.id, n.name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC
LIMIT 4;

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT CompanyName,
         Location,
         CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Salary, '₹', ''), ',', ''), '/yr', '') AS INTEGER) AS salary_yr
  FROM SalaryDataset
  WHERE Salary LIKE '%/yr'
),
national AS (
  SELECT AVG(salary_yr) AS national_avg FROM parsed
),
city_avg AS (
  SELECT Location, CompanyName, AVG(salary_yr) AS avg_salary
  FROM parsed
  WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
  GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT Location, CompanyName, avg_salary,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Location ORDER BY avg_salary DESC) AS rn
  FROM city_avg
)
SELECT r.Location AS Location,
       r.CompanyName AS "Company Name",
       ROUND(r.avg_salary, 2) AS "Average Salary in State",
       ROUND(n.national_avg, 2) AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked r
CROSS JOIN national n
WHERE r.rn <= 5
ORDER BY r.Location, r.rn;

WITH sv AS (
  SELECT name, version, step,
    MAX(CASE WHEN model <> 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS best_non_stack,
    MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS stack_score
  FROM model_score GROUP BY name, version, step
),
st AS (
  SELECT name, version,
    CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN best_non_stack < stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'strong'
         WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN best_non_stack = stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'soft' END AS status
  FROM sv WHERE stack_score IS NOT NULL AND best_non_stack IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY name, version
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT st.status, m.L1_model, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
  FROM st JOIN model m ON m.name = st.name AND m.version = st.version
  WHERE st.status IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY st.status, m.L1_model
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT status, L1_model, occurrences,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY occurrences DESC) AS rk
  FROM cnt
)
SELECT status, L1_model, occurrences FROM ranked WHERE rk = 1 ORDER BY status;

SELECT 4280 AS product_id, 'C' AS aisle, 1 AS position, 65 AS location_id, 1193 AS inventory_id, 36 AS pick_qty, '2018-02-23' AS purchased
UNION ALL SELECT 4280, 'D', 18, 114, 1250, 24, '2018-04-23'
UNION ALL SELECT 6520, 'A', 29, 29, 1316, 14, '2018-02-26'
UNION ALL SELECT 6520, 'C', 13, 77, 1205, 20, '2018-02-26'
UNION ALL SELECT 6520, 'A', 16, 16, 1262, 6, '2018-04-26'

WITH RECURSIVE start AS (
  SELECT p.product_id, p.qty_minimum AS mn, p.qty_purchase AS pq,
         (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM inventory i WHERE i.product_id = p.product_id) AS inv0
  FROM product_minimums p
),
rec AS (
  SELECT product_id, 0 AS n, NULL AS m, inv0 AS end_inv, mn, pq FROM start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.product_id, r.n + 1, date('2019-01-01', '+' || r.n || ' months'),
         CASE WHEN r.end_inv - COALESCE(b.qty, 0) < r.mn
              THEN r.end_inv - COALESCE(b.qty, 0) + r.pq
              ELSE r.end_inv - COALESCE(b.qty, 0) END,
         r.mn, r.pq
  FROM rec r
  LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b
    ON b.product_id = r.product_id AND b.mth = date('2019-01-01', '+' || r.n || ' months')
  WHERE r.n < 12
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT product_id, m, ABS(end_inv - mn) AS abs_diff,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(end_inv - mn)) AS rk
  FROM rec WHERE n >= 1
)
SELECT product_id, m AS month, abs_diff
FROM diffs WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH s AS (SELECT "loss_rate_%" AS r FROM veg_loss_rate_df WHERE "loss_rate_%" IS NOT NULL),
st AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS m, AVG(r*r) - AVG(r)*AVG(r) AS v, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s),
b AS (SELECT s.r, st.m, st.n, sqrt(st.v) AS sd FROM s, st)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(m), 4) AS avg_loss_rate,
       ROUND(MAX(sd), 4) AS std_dev,
       MAX(n) AS total_items,
       SUM(r < m - sd) AS below_1sd,
       SUM(r > m + sd) AS above_1sd,
       SUM(r BETWEEN m - sd AND m + sd) AS within_1sd
FROM b;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         substr(txn_date,1,7) AS ym,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount
                  WHEN txn_type IN ('withdrawal','purchase') THEN -txn_amount
                  ELSE 0 END) AS net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date,1,7)
),
months AS (SELECT DISTINCT ym FROM monthly),
cust AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM monthly),
bal AS (
  SELECT m.ym, c.customer_id,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(x.net),0) FROM monthly x
           WHERE x.customer_id = c.customer_id AND x.ym < m.ym) AS prev_bal
  FROM months m CROSS JOIN cust c
)
SELECT ym AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN prev_bal > 0 THEN prev_bal ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_prev_balance
FROM bal
WHERE ym > (SELECT MIN(ym) FROM monthly)
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE dates(d) AS (
  SELECT MIN(txn_date) FROM customer_transactions
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(d, '+1 day') FROM dates WHERE d < (SELECT MAX(txn_date) FROM customer_transactions)
),
cust AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) AS first_d, MAX(txn_date) AS last_d
  FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id
),
daily AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net
  FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
grid AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, dates.d AS d, c.first_d
  FROM cust c JOIN dates ON dates.d >= c.first_d AND dates.d <= c.last_d
),
bal AS (
  SELECT g.customer_id, g.d, g.first_d,
         SUM(COALESCE(dl.net, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY g.customer_id ORDER BY g.d) AS balance
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN daily dl ON dl.customer_id = g.customer_id AND dl.txn_date = g.d
),
roll AS (
  SELECT customer_id, d, first_d, balance,
         AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg30
  FROM bal
),
elig AS (
  SELECT customer_id, d, first_d, MAX(0, avg30) AS avg30
  FROM roll
  WHERE julianday(d) - julianday(first_d) >= 29
),
maxm AS (
  SELECT customer_id, first_d, substr(d, 1, 7) AS mon, MAX(avg30) AS mx
  FROM elig GROUP BY customer_id, substr(d, 1, 7)
)
SELECT mon AS month, ROUND(SUM(mx), 2) AS sum_of_max_30d_avg_balance
FROM maxm
WHERE mon > substr(first_d, 1, 7)
GROUP BY mon
ORDER BY mon;

WITH RECURSIVE bounds AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) AS mn, MAX(txn_date) AS mx
  FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id
),
days(customer_id, d, mx) AS (
  SELECT customer_id, mn, mx FROM bounds
  UNION ALL
  SELECT customer_id, date(d, '+1 day'), mx FROM days WHERE d < mx
),
daily AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net
  FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
running AS (
  SELECT g.customer_id, g.d,
         SUM(COALESCE(dl.net, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY g.customer_id ORDER BY g.d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS bal
  FROM days g LEFT JOIN daily dl ON dl.customer_id = g.customer_id AND dl.txn_date = g.d
),
clamped AS (
  SELECT customer_id, d, MAX(0, bal) AS bal FROM running
),
cust_month_max AS (
  SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', d) AS month, MAX(bal) AS max_bal
  FROM clamped GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT month, SUM(max_bal) AS monthly_total
FROM cust_month_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT session, path,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp ASC) AS rn_first,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp DESC) AS rn_last
  FROM activity_log
),
pages AS (
  SELECT session, path FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1 OR rn_last = 1
  GROUP BY session, path
)
SELECT path, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM pages
GROUP BY path
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TOTAL', COUNT(*) FROM pages;
